Sport Recife's great hope of avoiding relegation in the Brasileirão [Brazil's main soccer league] in the next few rounds, striker Hugo is expected to be indicted, in the next few days, by one of the agents who carried out his deal with the UAE, for the crime of tax evasion.
If the debt is proven, he'll have to pay all the taxes not paid during the transaction, as well as a hefty fine.
examples.ref: 2012 November 23, Paulinho, “Atacante Hugo, do Sport, pode ser denunciado por sonegação de impostos na Receita Federal [Sport striker Hugo might be indicted for tax evasion by Brazil's revenue service]”, in Blog do Paulinho [Paulie's Blog]:
examples.text:
Grande esperança do Sport Recife para evitar o rebaixamento no Brasileirão nas próximas rodadas, o atacante Hugo deve ser denunciado, nos próximos dias, por um dos agentes que realizou sua transação aos Emirados Árabes, pelo crime de Sonegação Fiscal.
Em comprovada a dívida, terá que arcar com todos os impostos não pegos no período da transação, além de pesada multa.
examples.translation:
Sport Recife's great hope of avoiding relegation in the Brasileirão [Brazil's main soccer league] in the next few rounds, striker Hugo is expected to be indicted, in the next few days, by one of the agents who carried out his deal with the UAE, for the crime of tax evasion.
If the debt is proven, he'll have to pay all the taxes not paid during the transaction, as well as a hefty fine.

source_metadata.etymology_text: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese janella, from Vulgar Latin *iānuella, diminutive of Latin iānua (“door”). Compare Galician xanela, Mirandese jinela. Related to Mozarabic יאנה (yʔnh).

examples.english: It started raining! Shut the windows!
examples.text: Começou a chover! Fecha as janelas!
examples.translation: It started raining! Shut the windows!

examples.ref: 1899, Machado de Assis, chapter 32, in Dom Casmurro, Rio de Janeiro: H. Garnier, Livreiro-Editor:
examples.text: Fui devagar, mas o pé ou o espelho traiu-me. Este pode ser que não fosse; era um espelhinho de pataca (perdoai a barateza), comprado a um mascate italiano, moldura tosca, argolinha de latão, pendente da parede, entre as duas janelas.

examples.english: When I sit at the window / I see through the panes clouded by snow / The sweet image of her / When (she) passes… passes… passes…
examples.text: Quando eu me sento à janela / P'los vidros qu'a neve embaça / Vejo a doce imagem d'ela / Quando passa… passa… passa…
examples.translation: When I sit at the window / I see through the panes clouded by snow / The sweet image of her / When (she) passes… passes… passes…

source_metadata.etymology_text: Semi-learned borrowing from Latin comprehendere (“to grasp”). Cf. the older variant comprehender, as well as the inherited comprender. The latter was likely modified into its current form to more closely reflect the Latin etymology.

examples.english: I understand your reasons, but they don't justify your acts.
examples.text: Eu compreendo seus motivos, mas eles não justificam seus atos.
examples.translation: I understand your reasons, but they don't justify your acts.

examples.english: The Gypsy, appearing to comprehend those words, straightened up, and, laying her paws on the girl’s lap, kissed her hands lovingly...
examples.ref: 1880, Maria Amalia Vaz de Carvalho, “A Cigana [Gypsy]”, in Contos e phantasias [Short stories and fantasies]^(https://pt.wikisource.org/wiki/Contos_e_phantasias_(Maria_Amália_Vaz_de_Carvalho,_1905)), 2nd edition, Lisbon: Parceria Antonio Maria Pereira, published 1905, page 146:
examples.text: A Cigana, parecendo comprehender aquellas palavras, endireitou-se, e pousando as patas no collo da menina, beijou-lhe carinhosamente as mãos...
examples.translation: The Gypsy, appearing to comprehend those words, straightened up, and, laying her paws on the girl’s lap, kissed her hands lovingly...

examples.ref: 2007, Ram Charan, Know-how: as 8 competências que separam os que fazem dos que não fazem, Elsevier Brasil, →ISBN, page 74:

examples.text: Todo aquelle conjuncto de graças ia ser d’elle outra vez.
examples.translation: That whole bundle of graces would be his once again.
